001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service;
002
003import android.content.Context;
004import android.content.Intent;
005import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResult;
006import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
007import com.google.android.gms.auth.api.signin.GoogleSignIn;
008import com.google.android.gms.auth.api.signin.GoogleSignInAccount;
009import com.google.android.gms.auth.api.signin.GoogleSignInClient;
010import com.google.android.gms.auth.api.signin.GoogleSignInOptions;
011import com.google.android.gms.common.api.ApiException;
012import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
013import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Completable;
014import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single;
015import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.SingleEmitter;
016import io.reactivex.rxjava3.schedulers.Schedulers;
017import javax.inject.Inject;
018import javax.inject.Singleton;
019
020
021
022/**
023 * Provides authentication and session management for Google Sign-In functionality within the app.
024 * This service offers methods for silent sign-in, explicit sign-in initiation and completion, and
025 * signing out of Google accounts, leveraging the Google Sign-In API and RxJava for asynchronous
026 * handling of operations.
027 *
028 * This class relies on dependency injection to initialize a {@link GoogleSignInClient} instance
029 * using the application context.
030 */
031@Singleton
032public class GoogleSignInService {
033
034  private final GoogleSignInClient client;
035
036  /**
037   * Initializes an instance of {@code GoogleSignInService} with a configured {@link GoogleSignInClient}.
038   * The configuration specifies that email, profile, and ID information should be requested from
039   * the user's Google account upon sign-in.
040   *
041   * @param context The application context used to build the {@link GoogleSignInClient} instance.
042   */
043  @Inject
044  GoogleSignInService(@ApplicationContext Context context) {
045    GoogleSignInOptions options = new GoogleSignInOptions.Builder()
046        .requestEmail()
047        .requestProfile()
048        .requestId()
049        .build();
050    client = GoogleSignIn.getClient(context, options);
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Performs a silent sign-in using the {@link GoogleSignInClient} to attempt retrieval of the
055   * last signed-in Google account asynchronously. If successful, the sign-in account is returned.
056   * If the operation fails, an error notification is sent to the subscriber.
057   *
058   * @return A {@link Single} emitting a {@link GoogleSignInAccount} object if the silent sign-in
059   * succeeds, or an error if the operation fails.
060   */
061  public Single<GoogleSignInAccount> refresh() {
062    return Single.create((SingleEmitter<GoogleSignInAccount> emitter) ->
063            client.silentSignIn()
064                .addOnSuccessListener(emitter::onSuccess)
065                .addOnFailureListener(emitter::onError)
066        )
067        .observeOn(Schedulers.io());
068  }
069
070  /**
071   * Initiates the Google Sign-In process by launching the Google Sign-In Intent
072   * provided by the {@link GoogleSignInClient}.
073   *
074   * @param launcher An {@link ActivityResultLauncher} that is used to start an activity
075   *                 to handle the Google Sign-In process and receive the result.
076   */
077  public void startSignIn(ActivityResultLauncher<Intent> launcher) {
078    launcher.launch(client.getSignInIntent());
079  }
080
081  /**
082   * Completes the Google Sign-In process by processing the result of a previously initiated
083   * sign-in activity. If the sign-in is successful, the account information is emitted. In case
084   * of an error, the error is propagated to the subscriber.
085   *
086   * @param result The {@link ActivityResult} containing the result data of the sign-in activity.
087   *               This data includes information necessary for obtaining the {@link GoogleSignInAccount}.
088   * @return A {@link Single} emitting a {@link GoogleSignInAccount} object if the sign-in
089   *         is successful, or an error if the process fails.
090   */
091  public Single<GoogleSignInAccount> completeSignIn(ActivityResult result) {
092    return Single.create((SingleEmitter<GoogleSignInAccount> emitter) -> {
093          try {
094            GoogleSignInAccount account = GoogleSignIn.getSignedInAccountFromIntent(result.getData())
095                .getResult(ApiException.class);
096            emitter.onSuccess(account);
097          } catch (ApiException e) {
098            emitter.onError(e);
099          }
100        })
101        .observeOn(Schedulers.io());
102  }
103
104  /**
105   * Signs out the currently authenticated user by invoking the sign-out functionality
106   * of the associated {@link GoogleSignInClient}. The operation is performed asynchronously,
107   * emitting either a completion signal or an error notification to the subscriber.
108   *
109   * @return A {@link Completable} that completes if the sign-out operation succeeds, or
110   * emits an error if the operation fails.
111   */
112  public Completable signOut() {
113    return Completable.create(emitter ->
114            client
115                .signOut()
116                .addOnSuccessListener((ignored) -> emitter.onComplete())
117                .addOnFailureListener(emitter::onError)
118        )
119        .observeOn(Schedulers.io());
120  }
121}
